== Notes ==
* Can be combined with [["I Meant to Do That!"]].
* If you are wearing [[Stonefist Insignia]], you will be knocked down an additional second as well. This has been confirmed to be intentional.
* The self-inflicted knock down occurs before stance removal, thus you can use anti-knockdown stances.
{{anomaly|This skill has no [[aftercast delay]], though this can only be observed if the self knockdown is prevented.}}

== Trivia ==
